answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded escrow account whose balance is attested on a shared ledger, so a tundra of pseudonyms still maps to one auditable capital pool. Forensic reconciliation tracks every opal-tagged credential against signed transaction deltas, flagging the delta between claimed stake and settled funds as collusion evidence. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
